title: [Master] - Slice 641282: [Sustainability][Value Chain] FA Reclassification Journal: add CO2e reclassification % field to split emissions like Acq. Cost %
summary: A new Reclassify CO2e % field was added to the FA Reclassification Journal to allow CO2e emissions to be reclassified independently from acquisition cost percentages.
key_points: New Reclassify CO2e % field added to FA Reclassification Journal Line table extension
Field validation requires Sust. Account No. or New Sust. Account No. to be set
Journal subscriber updated to use the new CO2e percentage field instead of acquisition cost percentage for emission reclassification
New field exposed on the FA Reclassification Journal page
Test cases added to verify the functionality with different and zero CO2e percentages
quote: Adds a new Reclassify CO2e % field to the FA Reclassification Journal so CO2e emissions can be reclassified independently of Reclassify Acq. Cost %.
